science.contract: Lossless symmetric s-polarized Fresnel model; Snell geometry; exact total internal-return sum; same outgoing-wavefront optical path; R+T=1; matched-index and zero-thickness cancellation; explicitly bounded propagating domain.
limitations: Prescribed drainage is not a hydrodynamic solution.
Three-wavelength display is not measured white-light colorimetry.
Wedge settling is a geometric interpolation, not a mechanical simulation.
Absorption, dispersion, total internal reflection and frustrated transmission are excluded.
